import sys
sys.path.append('/path/to/tools')
from tools import search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_restaurants, search_nearest, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache, sort_results

# Retrieve cached restaurant search results
restaurant_results = get_results_from_cache(key="previous_restaurants")

# Search for flights from Atlanta to St. Louis for both dates
flights_outbound = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Atlanta",
    end_airport_city="St. Louis",
    departure_date=["May 16, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

flights_return = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="St. Louis",
    end_airport_city="Atlanta",
    departure_date=["May 25, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Filter flights to apply economy class preference
flights_outbound = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights_outbound,
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

flights_return = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights_return,
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="flights_outbound", value=flights_outbound)
save_to_cache(key="flights_return", value=flights_return)

# Search for hotels in Downtown St. Louis with free parking
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["May 16, 2025", "May 22, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["May 25, 2025", "May 25, 2025"],
    num_rooms=1,
    budget=70,
    free_wifi_included=True,
    airport_shuttle_present=False,
    has_free_parking=True
)

# Filter hotels to apply free parking preference
hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    free_wifi_included=True,
    has_free_parking=True
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Filter restaurants to apply dietary restrictions
restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=restaurant_results,
    has_dairy_allergy_options=False,
    cuisine=["Chinese"]
)

# Save restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants)

print("No planning needed")
